cookie.title: Dukurikiza Ubwangano Bwawe
cookie.description: Dukoresha cookie kugira ngo duhuze uburambe bwawe mu gucukumbura, dutange ibikubiyemo kandi dushyire mu ivuga yacu. Usibye ku kanda "Emera Vyose", wemera ko dukoresha cookie. Urashobora guhindura amatoranya yawe cyangwa ukane cookie zidafite akamaro.
cookie.functionalDesc: Zibuka icyo wifuza mu rurimi n'ahantu
cookie.analyticsDesc: Zitufasha kumva uko abashitsi bakoresheje urubuga

privacyPolicy.title: Politiki y'Ibanga
privacyPolicy.heroDesc: Uko Conseil Protestant du Rwanda yakusanya, ifata, no kurinda amakuru yawe mugihi uri koresheje urubuga bwacu.
privacyPolicy.contactIntro: Niba ufite ibibazo bijyanye na Poliitiki y'Ibanga cyangwa uko dufata amakuru yawe, nyamuneka tubwire:

sections.title: 1. Intangiriro
paragraphs: Conseil Protestant du Rwanda (CPR), iri i KG 2 Av 4, B.P 79, Kigali, Rwanda, ni yo ikora iri rubuga. Iyi Politiki y'Ibanga yerekana amakuru dukusanya, uko tuyakoresha, n'uburenganzira ufite.
Iyo ukoresheje iri rubuga, wemera uburyo bwaranditse muri iyi politiki.

sections.title: 2. Amakuru Dukusanya
paragraphs: Twagabanya cyane gukusanya amakuru. Hakurikije uko ukoresheje urubuga, dushobora kukusanya:
list: Amakuru ahuriwe n'ubwifuza (amazina, imeyili, nimero ya telefoni) uramwo utse urupapuro rw'ubwanditsi
Amakuru y'ikoresha ry'urubuga nka paji zasuye n'ururimi wahishe, bibikwa ku mugendanwa wawe

sections.title: 3. Uko Dukoresha Amakuru Yawe
paragraphs: Dukoresha amakuru twakusanyije gusa kugira ngo tusubize ibibazo byawe, tuzamure uburambe bw'urubuga, kandi tukomenyeshe ibikorwa bya CPR iyo wabitumiye.
Ntidugurisha, ntitwakira, cyangwa kutugurisha amakuru yawe bwite.

sections.title: 4. Cookie na Uburyo bwo Gukurikirana
paragraphs: Iri rubuga rukoresha gusa cookie zingenzi n'ububiko bwa mushakisha (nka localStorage) kugira ngo ubike ururimi watoranije n'icyo wiyemeje ku cookie.
Nta cookie y'amatangazo cyangwa ikurikirana ibindi rubuga irikoreshwa. Ushobora kuyasiba cyangwa kuzibira muri mushakisha yawe igihe cyose; urubuga rurakomeza gukora.

sections.title: 5. Gusangira no Gutangaza Amakuru
paragraphs: Ntidusangira amakuru yawe bwite n'abandi, keretwe iyo ari ngombwa kugira ngo urubuga rukore (urugero: abatanga serivisi y'ibikinisha n'ibibanza), cyangwa iyo amategeko y'u Rwanda abisaba.

sections.title: 6. Umutekano w'Amakuru
paragraphs: Dukoresha ingamba zKW'ikoranabuhanga n'imicungire zikwiye zo kurinda amakuru dufite. Ariko, nta buryo bwo kohereza amakuru kuri interineti bushobora kwizwa neza kandi ntidushobora kwemerera umutekano wuzuye.

sections.title: 7. Serivisi z'Abandi Bafatanyabikorwa
paragraphs: Urubuga bwacu rukenera abanyamuryango bake b'icyizere, nka serivisi y'ibibanza n'iyohereza amakuru, kugira ngo rukore. Abo batanga serivisi bakora amakuru gusa mu izina ryacu.

sections.title: 8. Uburenganzira Bwawe
paragraphs: Ushobora kudusaba igihe cyose kureba, gukosora, cyangwa gusiba amakuru yawe bwite wadusangiye, uduhamagara uko bigendereye hasi.
Ushobora kandi kwanka uburemere bwa cookie igihe cyose ukuraho ububiko bwa mushakisha yawe.

sections.title: 9. Ibanga ry'Abana
paragraphs: Urubuga bwacu ntitugamije ku bana bari munsi y'imyaka 13, kandi ntidukusanya umenyaguhisha amakuru y'abana.

sections.title: 10. Guhindura Iyi Politiki
paragraphs: Dushobora guhindura iyi Politiki y'Ibanga buri gihe. Impinduka zose zizashyirwa kuri iyi paji n'itarike nshya y'ivugururwa.

sections.title: 11. Twandikire
paragraphs: Niba ufite ibibazo bijyanye na Poliitiki y'Ibanga cyangwa uko dufata amakuru, nyamuneka utubwire.

termsOfService.title: Amabwiriza yo Gukoresha
termsOfService.heroDesc: Amategeko agenga uko ukoresheje urubuga rwa Conseil Protestant du Rwanda.
termsOfService.contactIntro: Niba ufite ibibazo bijyanye n'Ama wiriza yo Gukoresha, nyamuneka tubwire:

sections.title: 1. Kwemera Amabwiriza
paragraphs: Aya mabwiriza agenga uko ukoresheje urubuga rwa CPR. Iyo uvuye cyangwa ukoresheje iri rubuga, wemera kuyakurikiza.
Niba utemera kimwe muri aya mabwiriza, nyamuneka ntukoresheshe urubuga.

sections.title: 2. Ibyerekeye Iri Rubuga
paragraphs: Iri rubuga rikorwa na Conseil Protestant du Rwanda (CPR) kugira ngo itangaze amakuru yerekeye inshingano yayo, amatorero yayo, amashami yayo, umurimo wa radiyo, amakuru, n'ibikorwa.
Ibikubiyemo byanditse mu Cyongereza, igifaransa, n'ikinyarwanda. Iyo hari itandukaniro hagati y'indimi, iyo mu Cyongereza ni yo ifite agaciro.

sections.title: 3. Gukoresha Ibikubiyemo
paragraphs: Ibikubiyemo byose biri kuri iri rubuga — harimwo inyandiko, amafoto, ibiratso, n'inyandiko nyamukuru — ni ibya CPR cyangwa abafatanyabikorwa bayo kandi birindwiwe n'amategeko.

Urashobora kureba, sibura, no gusangira ibikubiyemo ku ntego ziteganyijwe no kwigisha cyangwa ku bijyanye n'itorero, ugahanura inkomoko. Gukoresha mu bucuruzi bishyira ku mpatanabwenge yanditse itangira.

sections.title: 4. Impano
paragraphs: Iyo urubuga ruhisha gutanga impano cyangwa inkunga ku bikorwa bya CPR, ama faranga akoreshwa hakurikije inshingano ya CPR: kwizera, ubumwe, n'iterambere rirambye.
Impango ni ubwishyu kandi, keretwe byaravuzwe, ntizigomba kugarurwa. Ku kibazo cyose cyerekeye impano, nyamuneka utubwire.

sections.title: 5. Amahuza y'Ibinyabiziga
paragraphs: Iri rubuga rushobora kugira amahuza y'ibindi binyabiziga. Ntituzi cyangwa ntidushinzwe ibikubiyemo cyangwa uburyo bwabo bwo kubika amakuru.

sections.title: 6. Uko Bakoresheja Neza
paragraphs: Iyo ukoresheje iri rubuga cyangwa utubwira mu buryo bwacyo, wemerera kutohereza ibikubiyemo bidakwiye, bidahuye n'amategeko, cyangwa bidakoze neza, kandi kutagerageza guhagarika cyangwa gukoresha nabi urubuga cyangwa ibishinzwe rwo.

sections.title: 7. Kugabanya Icyaha
paragraphs: Urubuga rutangwa rukirira "nk'irihari" kandi "nka rubushakashatsi". Nubwo dukorera ko amakuru ari kuri n'ameza, CPR ntihaza kandi ntihashinzwe ibyangiza biva ku gukoresha urubuga.

sections.title: 8. Guhindura Aya Mabwiriza
paragraphs: Dushobora kongera gusubirwamo aya mabwiriza buri gihe. Uko ukomeza gukoresha urubuga nyuma y'uko impinduka zashyizwe ahagaragara bivuga ko wazemeye.

sections.title: 9. Amategeko Agenda
paragraphs: Aya mabwiriza agenga ku mategeko ya Repubulika y'u Rwanda.

sections.title: 10. Twandikire
paragraphs: Ku kibazo cyose cyerekeye Aya Mabwiriza yo Gukoresha, nyamuneka utubwire.
